== Overview ==

'''NintendoFriendPresenceV2Protocol''' is the friends service used by the Wii U. It provides a way for users to manage their friends list, friend requests and blacklist, as well as to share their presence, Mii, status message and preferences with their friends. It is the Wii U counterpart of [[NEX/Protocols/NintendoFriendPresenceProtocol|NintendoFriendPresenceProtocol]], which is used by the 3DS, and is used in place of the stock [[NEX/Protocols/FriendsProtocol|FriendsProtocol]].

The server notifies clients about changes made by other users through [[NEX/Protocols/NintendoNotificationEventProtocol|NintendoNotificationEventProtocol]].

{{Noticebox|''The real names of most fields in this protocol are not known. The names which are listed do not come from [[NEX/DDL|DDL information]]. They come from leftover debugging strings in the Wii U's friends system module (<code>FPD</code>), where they name the parameters of the <code>nn::fp</code> functions whose values are sent in these methods. The names used by the protocol itself may differ.''}}

=== UpdateAndGetAllInformation ===

Updates the callers account information and presence, and returns everything related to the callers friends list. This includes the callers own preferences and status message, their friends, their sent and received friend requests, their blacklist and their notifications.

==== Request ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[#NNAInfo]] || Unknown || The callers network account information
|-
| [[#NintendoPresenceV2]] || Unknown || The callers presence
|-
| [[NEX/Types#DateTime|DateTime]] || Unknown || The callers birthday
|}

==== Response ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[#PrincipalPreference]] || Unknown || The callers preferences
|-
| [[#Comment]] || Unknown || The callers status message
|-
| [[NEX/Types#List|List]]&lt;[[#FriendInfo]]&gt; || Unknown || The callers friends
|-
| [[NEX/Types#List|List]]&lt;[[#FriendRequest]]&gt; || Unknown || Friend requests sent by the caller
|-
| [[NEX/Types#List|List]]&lt;[[#FriendRequest]]&gt; || Unknown || Friend requests received by the caller
|-
| [[NEX/Types#List|List]]&lt;[[#BlacklistedPrincipal]]&gt; || Unknown || The callers blacklist
|-
| Boolean || Unknown || Unknown
|-
| [[NEX/Types#List|List]]&lt;[[#PersistentNotification]]&gt; || Unknown || The callers notifications
|-
| Boolean || Unknown || Unknown
|}

=== AddFriendRequest ===

Sends a friend request to a user by their [[NEX/Types#PID|PID]].

==== Request ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[NEX/Types#PID|PID]] || principalId || Target user to send the friend request to
|-
| UInt8 || messageLanguage || The <code>cafe.language</code> value used for <code>pMessage</code>. See [[Nintendo_Network/IDBE#Languages|IDBE#Languages]]
|-
| [[NEX/Types#String|String]] || pMessage || Message to send in the friend request. May be empty. May be at most 63 codepoints long (codepoints outside the Basic Multilingual Plane count as 2)
|-
| UInt8 || inGameNameLanguage ||  The <code>cafe.language</code> value used for <code>pInGameName</code>. See [[Nintendo_Network/IDBE#Languages|IDBE#Languages]]
|-
| [[NEX/Types#String|String]] || pInGameName || An in-game name associated with the friend request. This value is supplied by the game sending the friend request, and may technically be anything. For example, Xenoblade Chronicles X sets this to the senders in-game name, not their NNID. May be empty. May be at most 16 codepoints long (codepoints outside the Basic Multilingual Plane count as 2)
|-
| [[#GameKey]] || Unknown || The title the sender was playing when the users played together. If the users did not play together, this is either the title the sender is currently playing or zeroed out
|-
| [[NEX/Types#DateTime|DateTime]] || Unknown || Time the users played together. If the users did not play together, this is either the time the friend request was sent or <code>2000-01-01 00:00:00</code>
|}

==== Response ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[#FriendRequest]] || Unknown || The resulting friend request
|-
| [[#FriendInfo]] || Unknown || The resulting friend information
|}

=== NintendoPresenceV2 ===

{{ClassInherits|path=Online/NEX/Types|Data}}

This class holds a users presence.

This is an updated version of [[NEX/Protocols/NintendoFriendPresenceProtocol#NintendoPresence|NintendoPresence]].

The names of the fields come from a mix of the original [[NEX/Protocols/NintendoFriendPresenceProtocol#NintendoPresence|NintendoPresence]] field names and debug strings for the IPC functions.

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[#ChangedFlags]] || Unknown. Likely <code>m_changedBitFlag</code> || Which fields changed their value recently
|-
| Boolean || Unknown || Whether or not the user is online
|-
| [[#GameKey]] || pGameKey, could also be <code>m_gameKey</code> || The title the user is playing
|-
| UInt8 || Unknown || Set to the <code>cafe.language</code> value of the users console at login. See [[Nintendo_Network/IDBE#Languages|IDBE#Languages]]
|-
| [[NEX/Types#String|String]] || pDescription, could also be <code>m_gameModeDescription</code> || Game mode description. This value is supplied by the title, and may technically be anything. May be empty. May be at most 127 codepoints long (codepoints outside the Basic Multilingual Plane count as 2)
|-
| UInt32 || Unknown. Likely <code>m_joinAvailabilityFlag</code> || Whether or not the user can be joined. <code>0</code> if the user cannot be joined, <code>1</code> or <code>2</code> if the user can be joined, <code>0x65</code> or <code>0x66</code> if only invited users can join. This value is supplied by the title
|-
| UInt8 || Unknown. Likely <code>m_matchmakeSystemType</code> || [[NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol#MatchmakeSystemType|MatchmakeSystemType]]. Must not be <code>MATCHMAKE_SYSTEM_TYPE_INVALID</code> for the user to be joinable. If <code>2</code>, only friends of the user in the [[NEX/Types#PID|PID]] field can join. This value is supplied by the title
|-
| UInt32 || joinGameId, could also be <code>m_joinGameID</code> || Game server ID
|-
| UInt32 || Unknown. Likely <code>m_joinGameMode</code> || Must be less than <code>64</code> for the user to be joinable. This value is supplied by the title
|-
| [[NEX/Types#PID|PID]] || Unknown. Likely <code>m_ownerPrincipalID</code> || [[NEX/Types#PID|PID]] of a user. This value is supplied by the title. If only invited users can join, this is the number of invited users instead
|-
| UInt32 || Unknown. Likely <code>m_joinGroupID</code> || Gathering ID. Must not be <code>0</code> for the user to be joinable
|-
| [[NEX/Types#Buffer|Buffer]] || Unknown. Likely <code>m_applicationArg</code> || Application data. This value is supplied by the title, and may technically be anything. Always 20 bytes. If only invited users can join, this is a list of up to 5 UInt32 [[NEX/Types#PID|PIDs]] of the invited users instead
|-
| UInt8 || Unknown || The region of the users console. <code>1</code> for JPN, <code>2</code> for USA, <code>3</code> for EUR, <code>5</code> for CHN, <code>6</code> for KOR, <code>7</code> for TWN
|-
| UInt8 || Unknown || The <code>cafe.language</code> value of the users console. See [[Nintendo_Network/IDBE#Languages|IDBE#Languages]]
|-
| UInt8 || Unknown || Always <code>3</code>?
|}

== Flags ==

=== ChangedFlags ===

{{Noticebox|''The real name of this type is not known, and neither are the names of its flags. Only their values are known.''}}

Specifies which fields of a [[#NintendoPresenceV2]] changed their value recently.

<pre>
enum ChangedFlags : uint32_t {
  ...
};
</pre>

{| class="wikitable"
! Name !! Value !! Description
|-
| Unknown || 0x001 || <code>pGameKey</code> changed
|-
| Unknown || 0x002 || <code>pDescription</code> changed
|-
| Unknown || 0x004 || <code>m_joinAvailabilityFlag</code> changed
|-
| Unknown || 0x008 || <code>m_matchmakeSystemType</code> changed
|-
| Unknown || 0x010 || <code>joinGameId</code> changed
|-
| Unknown || 0x020 || <code>m_joinGameMode</code> changed
|-
| Unknown || 0x040 || The [[NEX/Types#PID|PID]] changed
|-
| Unknown || 0x080 || The gathering ID changed
|-
| Unknown || 0x100 || The application data changed
|}
